blocks.html: The data required to create a single-use password reset token.

types.name: CreatePasswordResetTokenDTO
types.description: The data required to create a single-use password reset token.

children.name: provider
children.description: The ID of the authentication provider, e.g. `emailpass`.

children.name: entity_id
children.description: The identifier of the entity requesting the reset, typically the email.

children.name: ttl_seconds
children.description:
Optional token lifetime in seconds. Defaults to the module's password
reset TTL when omitted.
